description: Equipo de jóvenes olímpicos en matemáticas descubriendo diferentes formas de divertirnos con ciencia.
summary:
πRex in Space is an interactive game which consists on administrating a space base in the Moon or Mars, managing water, oxygen, energy, food and other resources to survive and complete the mission. In the game, the playable characters are a crew of six astronauts: Pi, Euler, Noether, Fibonacci, Ramanujan and Gauss, in an expedition on one  of the 6 available maps (Shackleton Crater, Sea of Tranquility, Tycho Crater, Jezero Crater, Olympus Mons and Valles Marineris) that lasts 30 days. In each day, the crew has to perform several tasks and manage oxygen, water, food, heat & sickbay and other resources, in order to survive and complete the mission.

This game is thought to introduce children into the vast territory of space exploration and what has an astronaut to do.
details:
What does it do or how does it work?

There are 6 maps in total, 3 lunar maps and 3 martian maps:

MOON (More radiation, less gravity) - HARD

–Sea of Tranquility

–Tycho Crater

–Shackleton Crater

MARS (Less Radiation, Solar Panel Contamination) – NORMAL

–Olympus Mons

–Jezero Crater

–Valles Marineris

Each day, the six astronauts of the crew must perform daily tasks to gather enough energy (⚡️) to manage well the following resources and materials:

–Oxygen (O₂)

–Water

–Food

–Anti-radiation shield (radiation dose increases if not covered)

–Heating & sickbay energy

As well, other materials exist to help in construction and fulfilling the mission:

–Metal: Building solar pannels and rescue rocket

–Spare parts: Repairing in case of an emergency (e.g. damaged oxygen tank)

–Samples: Can be obtained sample-mining, these must be sent to Earth via Sample Rocket

–Science Points: With enough of them you can access to upgrades

According to their role is their type of task:

–Pi (Commander): Can perform general missions (not marked with specific name). Special ability: Pep talk

–Euler (O₂ Engineer): Tasks related with the O₂ plant, revising the Life Support Module and Ice Water collection. Special ability: Turbo electrolysis

–Noether (Doctor): Related with crew health and trivia questions. Special ability: Heal +30 everyone on the crew

–Fibocanni (Botanist): Related with greenhouse seeding and harvest. Special ability: Turbo harvest

–Ramanujan (Geologist): Related with mining and sample-mining. Special ability: More precision while mining

–Gauss (Solar Engineer): Related with solar panels, energy cells and collection. Special ability: Clean solar panels

–Ro-Bi [NO TASK] (Assistant robot): By pressing H you can ask Ro-Bi when having doubts, also helping while collecting materials.

As well, the crew will provide of several modules in the base to complete these functions:

–Life Support: From this module, the player is able to divide the total available energy in the categories of: Oxygen production, Greenhouse, Heating & sickbay, and Shield, in addition to repairing the damaged modules

–Oxygen Plant: You can accelerate the oxygen production by entering this module sacrificing water via electrolysis

–Greenhouse: Here grows the food, that needs to wait 2 days before harvest

–Antenna: You can send data

–Sickbay: Here, Noether can revise the health state of each member

–Laboratory: You can obtain upgrades, such as increasing Ro-Bi's resource radar radius

–Sample Mine: For obtaining samples

–Sample Rocket Launcher: To send at least 3-sample packages to Earth

–Main Rocket: The final rocket that will send the crew to Earth

The mission, which last 30 days, can have a launching window since Day 20. When radiation dose surpasses 30, Earth will send everyone home.
